title: Entity details
responsibility: Chooses contract summary, measurements or source within entity details.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.entity
inputs.description: The current explorer entity provides the name, unit, and category used by the detail panel and its child views. The name labels the tabpanel; the unit and category are passed to the relevant detail panels.

examples.name: Entity details
examples.purpose: Chooses contract summary, measurements or source within entity details.

unit.title: Entity details
unit.responsibility: Chooses contract summary, measurements or source within entity details.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.contract
inputs.description: Prepared contract summary rows passed to EntityContract in the default branch. The source, measurements, and summary tabs do not render this value.

items.name: Entity
items.text: Provides the entity identity and associated HarnessUnit to the detail panels.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.measure
inputs.description: Precomputed size and performance rows passed to EntitySummary in the default contract branch and the summary tab. The source and measurements tabs do not render it.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.record
inputs.description: A verification record for the entity, or null when none is available; it is passed to EntityMeasures only on the measurements tab. With null, that panel says no verification record measured this revision.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.tab
inputs.description: When undefined, the component renders the contract with its measurement summary; 'source', 'measurements', and 'summary' select their corresponding panels. Other ExplorerTab values follow the default contract branch.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.repository
inputs.description: Optional GitHub repository base URL used to create source links. Links require the exact github.com owner/repository pattern, a lowercase 40- or 64-character hexadecimal commit, and a safe relative file path; otherwise the files remain unlinked.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.commit
inputs.description: The revision commit passed to EntitySource for source links. It must be a lowercase 40- or 64-character hexadecimal hash, and a link is produced only when repository and file path validation also pass.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.nav
inputs.description: Optional revision-scoped navigation object passed to EntitySource on the Source tab. File actions are omitted when it is undefined, and an action has no callback unless nav.source is supplied.

outputs.name: EntityDetails
outputs.description: Renders an accessible tabpanel with source files, measured detail, summary alone, or the default contract-plus-summary view according to tab. At viewport widths up to 480px, measurement rows stack with visible Measured, Limit, and Note labels; this value is markup, not JSON.

errors.name: Source navigation callback error
errors.description: When the Source tab renders an enabled file action, its event handler invokes nav.source without catching exceptions, so a thrown value propagates. This path is unavailable when nav.source is absent and is not used on the other tabs.
